t: Dine tolesh beshabbat veden tochen vedin tiqqune maakal o meabbed velash
s: Dine tolesh beshabbat veden tochen vedin tiqqune maakal o meabbed velash ubo t"z seipim: chabile pia ezob veqorenit, hiknisan leyabbeshan leetzim — en mistappeqin mehen beshabbat. Hiknisan lemaakal behema, o apillu hiknisan bistam — hare setaman gam ken lemaakal behema, umuttar lehistappeq mehen. Veqotem veokel beyad, abal lo bikli kederek chol. Umolel hashsharbitin berashe etzbeotayv leekol hazzera shebbetokan, abal lo bekol hayyad kederek shehu oseh bechol:

Hamabbed et haor hu meabot melakot, shekken bammishkan hayu meabbedin orot techashim veelim. Vehammoleach et haor — chayyab mishshum meabbed, shehammelicha hi mitztzorke haibbud. Abal hammoleach basar chay, apillu molecho harbeh kede sheyyitqayyem zeman merubbeh velo yasriach — patur, sheen ibbud bookalin min hattora. Abal middibre soperim yesh ibbud bookalin. Velaken asur limloach basar chay, apillu kede leoklo chay beshabbat (im adayin lo nimlach lehakshiro middamo), lepi shehammelach moil lebasar chay (shello nimlach adayin) lerakkeko uletaqqeno ulehakshiro laakila, vedomeh leibbud. Veen tzarik lomar sheasur lemolcho kede sheyyitqayyem velo yasriach, apillu bimqom hepsed merubbeh, vaapillu nimlach vehukshar kebar middamo. Veken shear debarim asur limloach beshabbat kede sheyyitqayyemu, apillu bimqom hepsed merubbeh:

Veken asur laasot me melach merubbim, o shear mashqin im melach merubbim, latet letok hakkebashim, dehaynu mine yeraqot o shear debarim shekkobeshim lehitqayyem (apillu yokal mehem gam lealtar, sheeno toreach bishbil hachol lebad, mikkol maqom), kevan shekkobesh otam lehitqayyem — domeh leibbud, shehammelach meqayyeman. Veyesh omerim shehakkobesh asur mippene shehu kimbashshel middibre soperim. Vaapillu laasot me melach o shear mashqin im melach, shello latet letok hakkebashim ella litbol bahem et pitto, velatet letok hattabshil — asur laasot mehem harbeh beyachad, dehaynu laasot bebat achat letzorek tibbul shette seuddot, ella meat letzorek seudda achat bilbad (mippene shekkeshehu oseh mehem harbeh, nireh keillu oseh otam likbisha). Vaapillu letzorek seudda achat eno rashshay laasot ella samuk lasseudda, abal lo misseudda lisudda, mippene sheasur limloach shum dabar lehannicho shello leoklo lealtar, kemo sheyyitbaer. Vaapillu im noten baheme shemen ben netinat hammayim lintinat hammelach, vehashshemen meakkeb sheen hammelach mitareb yapeh im hammayim, umattish et kocho mihyot me melach azzin — ap al pi ken asur. Veim noten shene shelishe melach ushelish mayim o shear mashqim — asur laasot apillu meat letzorek tibbul seudda zo, mippene shennireh keoseh muryas likbosh bo dagim, sheddarko shel muryas laasoto kak, veasur likbosh beshabbat mishshum ibbud, o mishshum bishshul, kemo shennitbaer:

Kol dabar shehammelach moil lo leshannot et tibo, lerakkeko o lehaqshoto o lehapig meriruto vekayyotze beinyan zeh, kegon tzenon ubatzel veshum vekayyotze bahem middebarim hacharipim, shekkeshehem shohim bemelach hem mazziim veyotze merirutam venaasim qashim, veken polin vaadashim shennitbashshelu biqlippatan, shehammelach merakkek haqqoshi sheyyesh bahem mitztzad qelippatan, veken mine qishshuim (sheqqorin avgarqa"s) chayyin shehammelach moil lahem, veken kol dabar shergilim laasot mimmennu kebashim — asur limloach mehem yoter mechatika lebaddah kede leoklah lealtar, shekkeshehu moleach shette chatikot yachad, vekol shekken yoter — hare zeh nireh kekobesh kebashim. Vaapillu chatika achat shel tzenon vekayyotze bo — asur letabbelah bemelach lehashhotah harbeh bemilchah kede sheyyetze merirutah achar shettazzia, ki zehu domeh leibbud. Abal muttar lehatbil apillu kamma chatikot kol achat veachat lebaddah, ulehannichah lepanayv kede leoklam lealtar zo achar zo beli shihuy kol kak, veap im hen mishtahin shaa muetet umazziin qetzat — en bekak kelum. Ubilbad shello yashheh otam zeman arok, apillu beotah seudda atzmah, kegon mittechillat hasseudda ad sopah, kede sheyyazziu harbeh, shezzehu domeh leibbud, veasur apillu bachatika achat lebaddah. Veyesh oserim lehashhot kelal bemelach apillu shaa muetet, apillu chatika achat lebaddah. Velaken asur litbol shette chatikot achat achat lebaddah ulehannichan lepanayv leoklan miyyad zo achar zo, ki ad sheyyokal harishona tishheh hashsheniyya bemilchah, veeno muttar ella litbol chatika uleoklah tekep umiyyad. Veken nohagin. Veken haddin bekol dabar shehammelach moil lo. Ulepi sebara haacharona en hattaam bemah sheaseru limloach kamma chatikot beyachad mippene shennireh kekobesh kebashim, ella mishshum shead sheyyokal harishona tishheh hashsheniyya bemilchah, vekevan shehammelach moil lah — hare zeh domeh leibbud. Lepikak, mah shennahagu lachtok tzenon daq daq venotenin oto biqara umolechin oto veshopekin alayv chometz — en issur baddabar, ap al pi shezzehu domeh lemoleach harbeh chatikot beyachad sheasur apillu kede leekol lealtar, mikkol maqom kevan sheen mashhin otan kelal bemelach lebaddo ella shopekim alehem miyyad chometz uminim acherim — eno domeh leibbud. Vekol shekken im shopekim sham shemen, shehashshemen mattish et koach hammelach. Umikkol maqom, tzarik lizzaher lishpok et hashshemen o et hachometz tekep umiyyad achar hammelicha. Abal mah shennohagin qetzat sheosin yaraq (sheqqorin shlaty"n) shemmolechin hayyaraq techilla bipne atzmo umashhin oto kak, umesannenim hammayim sheyyotzeim mimmennu, veachar kak meorbim oto im shemen vechometz — zehu issur gamur, vedomeh yoter leibbud, kevan shehu mamtin ad sheyyeqabbel heteb hammelach:

Kol dabar sheen hammelach moil lo leshannot tibo ella shehu noten bo taam bilbad, kegon betza ubasar — [muttar lemolchan, umikkol maqom] asur limloach kede lehanniach lisudda acheret. Veyesh mi sheomer sheim yesh ezeh tzad shettob lo sheyyamlichennu akshav mimmah sheyyamlichennu achar kak samuk laakila, kegon sheakshav hu cham qetzat viqabbel hammelach betob yoter — en issur baddabar (veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel bedibre soperim im tzarik lekak):

Muttar lehashqot yeraqot telushim kede shello yikmeshu, shekkevan sheyyeraqot hallalu reuyim laakila beyoman — muttar lehashqotan kederek shemmuttar letaltelam. Abal im enan reuyim laakila hayyom, sheasurim betiltul — asur lehashqotan. Velaken asur lehadiach basar shello nimlach shechal yom shelishi lihyot beshabbat kede shello yeaser lebishshul, lepi shehu asur betiltul im hu basar qasheh sheeno rauy lakos oto, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"ch. Vaapillu im hu rak sherauy lakos — en lehaqel, shekkevan sheeno rotzeh leoklo hayyom — yesh issur bahadachato mishshum shettoreach mishshabbat lechol. Veeno domeh liraqot, sheruyim hayyom laakilat kol adam, veeno nikkar kelal shettoreach mishshabbat lechol, ki shemma yoklem hayyom, mah sheen ken basar chay sheeno rauy lakos ella lemi sheddato yapeh, vegam en darko kelal lekoseso chay ella lebashshelo, venikkar haddabar shettoreach mishshabbat lechol. Vaapillu al yede nokri en lehaqel, sheap shehittiru bimqom hepsed merubbeh laasot al yede nokri kol dabar sheeno ella mishshum shebut, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"z — mikkol maqom kan en hepsed kol kak im lo yedichennu, sheyyukal leoklo tzali:

Hatztzarik laduk pilpelin vekayyotze bahem litten letok hammaakal beshabbat — muttar liktosh oto beshinnuy gadol midderek hachol, kegon beyad shel sakkin vekayyotze bo, apillu harbeh beyachad. Abal lo bemadok, apillu eno shel eben kedarko bechol, ella shel etz vekayyotze bo. Veyesh omerim shetztzarik gam ken sheyyaduk gam ken betok haqqeara vekayyotze bah, abal lo bemakteshet, ap al pi shekkotesh beyad shel sakkin vekayyotze bo. Veen lasum happilpelin tok beged veyiktosh besakkin alayv, mippene shemmolid reach babbeged, ap al pi sheeno mitkavven lekak, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqy"a. Veyesh mattirin liktosh bammaktesh (vetob lehachamir bemaqom sheepshar). Abal asur lechattekam besakkin, apillu kede leekol miyyad. Vehu haddin lekol hattebalin sheen derek leoklam ella al yede taarobet:

Abal kol dabar harauy laakila kemot shehu veeno giddule qarqa, sheen bemino techina kelal, kegon basar mebushshal o tzali o gebina vekayyotze bahem — muttar lachtok daq daq (apillu shello leekol miyyad), mippene sheen techina bookalin. Vaapillu hi gebina qasha meod — muttar, shehare epshar leloosah beqoshi veshem okel aleha. Umuttar lechattekah (apillu mi sheeno yakol lilos) ben besakkin ben beqardom o megera, sheap shehem kelim shemmelaktam leissur — muttar letaltelam letzorek gupam, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"ch. Abal asur legorerah daq daq bemorag charutz baal pipiyyot (sheqqorin ry"b ayyzy"n bilshon ashkenaz), apillu kede leekol miyyad, dekevan shehakkeli meyuchad lekak — hare zeh derek chol, kemo shechiqat tebalin bemadok ubemakteshet, vehu haddin bikli acher hamyuchad lekak:

Abal basar chay, hoil veeno rauy ella lemi sheddato yapeh lakos oto shello kedarko — en shem okel alayv leinyan zeh, veshayyak bo techina. Velaken asur lechatteko daq daq lipne haopot. Veap al pi shehu rauy lakkelabim — en shem okel alayv bishbil kak, hoil veeno omed lakkelabim ella leadam o leopot, mechamat chashibuto, velahem eno rauy belo chatika zo:

Vekol zeh bedabar sheeno giddule qarqa, abal kol dabar shehu miggiddule qarqa, apillu hu okel gamur — yesh bo mishshum tochen, hoil veyesh bemino techina, dehaynu bitbua veqitnit. Ulepikak, asur lachtok hayyaraq daq daq kede leoklo, veken gerogerot vecharubim lipne zeqenim. Veim chatak daq daq — chayyab mishshum tochen. Abal muttar leparer hallechem daq daq lipne hattarnegolim, veen bazeh mishshum tochen, hoil ukebar nitchana hattebua shemmimmenna naasa hallechem, veen techina achar techina. Vekol zeh bechotek umanniach, veeno okel lealtar ella leachar shaa, abal muttar lachtok daq daq kede leekol lealtar, o bishbil acherim sheyyoklu lealtar, o bishbil tarnegolim sheyyoklu lealtar, mippene shello aseru al haadam leekol maakalo bachatikot gedolot o qetannot, im ken derek akilato kak hu leekol gam bachatikot qetannot, vekol shehu derek akila en bo mishshum melaka, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"t leinyan borer okel mittok happesolet kede leoklo lealtar, sheen bo mishshum melaka hoil vederek akila kak hu, umuttar apillu lekattechilla. Veyesh mepaqpeqim al hetter zeh. Venakon lachush ledibrehem lizzaher lachtok et hayyaraq (sheqqorin shlaty"n) lachatikot gedolot qetzat, sheaz en bo mishshum tochen ledibre hakkol. Abal bimdinatenu nahagu lachtok hatztzenon daq daq meod, veken betzalim, veyesh lahem al mi sheyyismeku. Veal kol panim tzerikim lizzaher shello yatchilu ad achar yetzia mibbet hakkeneset, shetztzarik sheyyehe samuk lisudda mammash, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"t leinyan borer:

Vekol zeh lachtok daq daq besakkin, abal laduk bemadok, apillu shel etz — asur apillu kede leekol miyyad. Vaapillu beokel gamur kemo gerogerot vecharubim lipne zeqenim, veken shum veshachalayim vekayyotze bahem meokalim hanniddokin — asur laduk otam apillu leekol miyyad. Abal muttar lerasseqan beshinnuy gadol, kegon beetz happarur o beyad shel sakkin vekayyotze bo, kemo shennitbaer bepilpelin:

En kotetin melach bemadok, apillu shel etz, ella tzarik shinnuy gadol, kegon lerasseqo beyado shel sakkin o beetz parur. Abal asur lechatteko besakkin daq daq (shekkevan sheeno rauy laakila ella al yede taarobet — dino kitbalin velo kebasar ugebina, ap al pi shehu gam ken eno miggiddule qarqa kemotam). Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemelach haggas bitchillato, abal melach shehaya daq mittechilla venitbashshel venaasa petitin — muttar lechatteko besakkin daq daq, kemo shemmuttar bepat, mishshum sheen tochen achar tochen, kemo shennitbaer:
Dabar sheeno chapetz leoklo (velo lehaakilo letinoq) lealtar — asur lelooso beshinnayv, mishshum techina:

Challot debash shennitrassequ mehakkavveret mibbeod yom — asur lerasseqan lehotzi mehen haddebash, mippene shehu maprid okel mippesolet, dehaynu haddebash harauy laakila mehashshaava sheenah reuya lo, veyesh bazeh mishshum mepareq, vegam mishshum borer okel mippesolet, veap al pi shemmerasseq kede leekol lealtar, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"k. Vaapillu yatza haddebash meatzmo — asur ad laereb, gezera shemma yerasseq beyadayim kede leoklo hayyom. Ella im ken nitrassequ hachallot mibbeod yom, sheaz muttar haddebash hayyotze mimmennu beshabbat, kedin zetim vaanabim shennitrassequ mibbeod yom, kemo shennitbaer sham ubesiman rn"b. Abal muttar leekol haddebash haddabuq al gabbe challot sabib, ap al pi shello nitrassequ mibbeod yom:

Asur lirdot debash mehakkavveret beshabbat middibre soperim, mippene sheddomeh letolesh. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehachallot hen debuqot bakkavveret, shennireh keoqer dabar miggiddulo. Abal im nitleshu mehakkavveret mibbeod yom umunnachim kak betokah — muttar lehotzian veleekol haddebash haddabuq al gabban sabib. Vaapillu hen debuqim bakkavveret, ella shennitrassequ betokah mibbeod yom vehaddebash tzap bakkavveret — muttar lehotzio uleoklo:

Hallash hu meabot melakot. Veeno chayyab bintinat hammayim letok haqqemach bilbad, ella ad sheyyegabbel kedarko bechol. Veen hamgabbel chayyab ella bidbarim shehem bene gibbul, kegon qemach o apar letit shel binyan. Abal eper vechol haggas umursan veqemach qali vekayyotze bahem — lav bene gibbul hen, vehamgabbelan patur. Abal asur middibre soperim legabbel qemach qali harbeh, shemma yabo legabbel qemach sheeno qali veyitchayyeb. Abal muttar legabbel et haqqali meat meat, shezzehu shinnuy midderek hachol (vaapillu im haggibbul hu ab veqasheh venireh kelash — muttar, kevan shemmegabbel beshinnuy). Abal tebua shello hebia shelish sheqqalu otah, veachar kak tachanu otah gassa vahare hi kechol, vehi hanniqret shetita — muttar legabbel mimmenna bechometz vekayyotze bo, apillu harbeh bebat achat. Vehu sheyyihyeh haggibbul rak, abal qasheh — asur, mippene shennireh kelash (ella im ken megabbel meat meat, kemo shennitbaer beqali). Vaapillu berak, tzarik leshannot meat im oseh harbeh bebat achat. Ketzad? Noten et hashshetita veachar kak noten et hachometz, im hu maqom shergilin bo bechol litten hachometz techilla, ubemaqom shergilin bechol litten hashshetita techilla — yittenu beshabbat hachometz techilla. Veyesh choleqin al kol zeh, veomerim sheen chilluq ben debarim shehem bene gibbul lidbarim sheenan bene gibbul, ubekullan chayyab bintinat mayim lebad o echad mishshear mashqin ume perot, ap al pi shello gibbel kelal, ki netinat hammayim zehu gibbulo. Ella im ken haggibbul hu rak, sheaz en kan lisha kelal, veen issuro ella middibre soperim, vehittiruhu letzorek hashshabbat al yede shinnuy sheyyitbaer, ben bidbarim shehem bene gibbul, ben bidbarim sheenan bene gibbul. Ulepikak, ben qali ben shetita — asur litten bahem hammashqeh beshabbat apillu beshinnuy midderek hachol, ella im ken hu gibbul rak, shez muttar litten beshinnuy, dehaynu litten hashshetita techilla veachar kak hachometz bemaqom shezzehu shinnuy, o lehepek bemaqom shehahepek hu shinnuy. Ukeshennoten beshinnuy muttar legabbel apillu harbeh bebat achat, kevan shehu gibbul rak. Abal gibbul ab — asur bekol inyan mishshum lash, ella im ken natan hammashqeh kebar mibbeod yom, azay muttar legabbel beshabbat (meat meat), ben beqali ben bishtita. Ulepi sebara harishona, chardal shellasho meereb shabbat — yakol leorbo bemashqeh lemachar, ben beyad ben bekap, velitten letoko debash. Ubilbad shello yitrop bekoach, ella meorbo meat meat: (chaser).
